profiles.name: catalog
profiles.definition: Native catalog capability/0.1: explicit original UMF preparation; current compatible acceptance and unchanged/historical retry; exact original reports; complete native catalog view; person-scoped module/source reads; caller-owned transaction; no administrative installation or module grants.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native catalog policy/0.1: ordinary authenticated person; registrar membership for acceptance, original reports and complete catalog view; current module reader or writer for person-scoped catalog and accepted document reads; exact installed release; READ COMMITTED; no installation administration authority.

profiles.name: direct_read
profiles.definition: Native direct read capability/0.4: rootless exact scalar object identity/key/live pages; independent directed edge identity/relationship pages; authority receipt visibility; committed native import provenance after deletion; current document-qualified module authority; read-only READ COMMITTED supported; no structured ownership, general historical records or compiler execution. Optional registered feed-consumer reached comparison returns true/false only for valid authorized issued receipts against committed protected checkpoints, with separate comparison profile. One-call live 1–3 qualified independent directed relationship hops return unique numeric-ordered terminal scalar objects with path-local cycle exclusion, or limited/not-established with no records and restart. Logical attempted-state/result/byte limits and ordinary deadlines; no exact backend allocation guarantee or staged snapshot resume.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native direct-read policy/0.1: ordinary authenticated person; current document-qualified reader or writer for object, property, relationship and endpoint dependencies used by each supported read; no writer-only gate; READ COMMITTED and supported read-only transactions; exact installed release; no raw table privileges.

profiles.name: import
profiles.definition: Native host-adopted import capability/0.1: immutable explicit original source documents; context and primary identity construction; per-record scalar object/independent edge import dispositions; original provenance and reservations; pending caller settlement; no engine-owned batches or verified commit.

profiles.name: feed
profiles.definition: Native caller-asserted feed capability/0.2: complete authority-database transactions below snapshot xmin; original catalog/report/configuration prerequisites; journal/source/reservation union; full historical module authority; read-only reproduction of original retained deliveries after ACK; ordinary-role full-prior source interval CAS ACK; caller asserts downstream durability; no verified application or retention release; no administration.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native caller-asserted feed policy/0.1: ordinary authenticated person enrolled under the consumer role and fresh registration; current reader or writer authority for every module in historical source documents; complete source scope with no filtered sibling; authority database and READ COMMITTED; source-only expected-prior ACK; no downstream verifier or retention release.

profiles.name: history
profiles.definition: Native retained history capability/0.1: committed entity mutation groups in xid/seq journal order below fixed snapshot xmin; exact wrapper/origin/physical correspondence and complete ordered group digest; original image revisions and definition pins; direct retained create/metadata version image or deleted version with its unmodified previous record; no current canonical row dependence; rootless scalar objects and independent edges; no archive, cleanup, general reducer, source-fact retrieval or broad reconstruction evidence claims.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native retained history policy/0.1: ordinary authenticated current module reader or writer; every historical property declaration owner and old/new edge endpoint owner required; original accepted revision/pin interpretation; read-only READ COMMITTED allowed; selected authority installation, source epoch and release; no live endpoint requirement; no raw-table privilege.

profiles.name: weft_execution
profiles.definition: Native Weft runtime query capability/0.4: actual accepted original documents and native mappings; explicit Weft-owned exact numeric preparation preserving original source/pins; bounded complete rootless scalar string/boolean/mathematical integer/decimal sources; equality filters/joins, counts, ordering/limits and alias expansion; original decimal tokens for all projections and exact Python int/Decimal results; validated finite stock-PostgreSQL numeric representability before predicates and parameters, with typed native-domain refusal rather than rounding; caller read-only or read-write READ COMMITTED transaction; complete document/module authority and current context checks; independent directed monomorphic HAS_RELATED/RELATED_KEYS forward and inverse with authored required string keys; exact bounded key tuples/truncation; entity-page and related-entity-page with ordered authored required string keys, complete bounded source uniqueness and caller-managed live continuation; ungrouped count-summary; no structured properties, grouped summary, float carriers or internal retry.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native Weft runtime query policy/0.1: ordinary original authenticated session person; complete current reader/writer authority for every selected original document module and declaration owner; independently safe fixed source functions with exact native mappings; final same-person/catalog/release check; no raw table privilege.
